content: Abraahaamo Ammanuwan Xilleedda
Yaatina, nuuni nuussi ashuwan zare gidiyaa Abraahaamo ayaa demmeedda gaanee?
Ayissi gooppe, Abraahaamo oosuwan xilleeddawaa gidooppe, aw ceeqettiyaabay de7ee; shin Xoossaa sinthan ceeqettana danddayenna.
Ayissi gooppe, Xoossaa Maxaafay waagii? “Abraahaamo Xoossaa ammaneedda; Xoossay hewaa aw xillotethaan paydeedda” yaagee.
Oothiyaa uray akkiya miishshaa barew bessina akkeeppe attin, aw coo imettiyaawaadan paydettenna.
Shin oosuwaa oothennaan, nagaranchchaa xillissiyaa Xoossaa ammaniyaa uraa, Xoossay A ammanuwan A xillissee.
Hawaadankka, ay oosuunne baynnaan, Xoossay xilluwaadan paydeedda asaa nashechchiyaabaa Daawite haasayeedda wode geeddawe hawaa.
yaagee.

Yaatina, ha Daawite hasayeedda anjjuu qaxxaretteedda asaa xalalaasseeyee? Woy qassi qaxxarettibeenna asatuwaassee? Ayissi gooppe nuuni, “Xoossaa Maxaafay, ‘Abraahaamo Xoossaa ammaneedda; Xoossay hewaa aw xillotethaan paydeedda’ yaagee” goytte.
Yaatina, hawe awude haneeddee? Abraahaamo qaxxaretti simmineyee? Woy qaxxarettanaappe kasennee? Qaxxarettanaappe kasennappe attin, qaxxarettina gidenna.

Guyyeppe I qaxxaretteedda; Xoossay A ammanuwaa diraw, I qaxxarettanaappe kase A xillo udeeddawaa erissanaw, A qaxxaray malla gideedda. Hewekka qassi qaxxarettennan Xoossaa ammaniyaa ubbatuwaa Xoossay xillo oothiide paydanaadan, unttunttoo Abraahaamo aawuwaa gidanaassa.
I qaxxaretteeddawanttookka aawuwaa; gidooppekka, unttunttu qaxxaretteedda diraassa gidenna; shin nu aawuwaa Abraahaamo qaxxarettanaappe kase ammaniyaa ammanuwaa malaa kaalliyaawanttookka aawuwaa.
Xoossay Immana Geeddabay Ammanuwan Akettee
Abraahaamossinne A zerethaw Xoossay, “Ha sa7aa taani hinttenttoo immana” yaageeddawe, Abraahaamo Xoossaa ammaniide xilleedda diraassappe attin, higgew I azazetteedda diraassa gidenna.
Ayissi gooppe, higgew azazettiyaawanttu Xoossay immana geeddawaa laattiyaawantta gidooppe, asaa ammanuu maaddennabaa gideedda; Xoossay geeddawekka mela gideedda;
higgii Xoossaa boshaa ahee; shin higgii baynnasaan higgiyaa menthiyaabay baawa.

Hewaa diraw, higgiyaa naagiyaawanttu xalalaw gidennaan, qassi Abraahaamo ammaneeddawaadan, ammaniyaa Abraahaame zerethaa ubbaw Xoossay immana geeddawe, woytaadan tumattanawe ammanuwaana. Abraahaamo nuussi ubbaw aawuwaa. Xoossaa Maxaafay, “Taani neena cora kawutethatoo aawo oothaaddi” giyaawaadan, hayqqeeddawanttoo de7uwaa immiyaa, bare azazuwan baynnabaa de7iyaabaadan oothiide xeesiyaa, I ammaneedda Xoossaa sinthan Abraahaamo nuussi ubbaw aawuwaa.

Xoossaa Maxaafay Abraahaamossi, “Ne zerethay hawaa keena gidana” yaageeddawaadan, hawaa keena gidana giide, nashechchaan naaganaw danddayenna wode, Abraahaamo ammaniidenne sinthappe demmana giide, nashechchaan naagiide, cora zerethaw aawuwaa gideedda.
He wode, Abraahaamo yelettoodeppe xeetu laythaa kumana haniyaa cimaa; shin bare daaburanchcha asatethaanne Saara na7aa yelanaw danddayennawaa qoppeedda wode, I bare ammanuwan daaburibeenna.
Xoossaa I bonchchiidde, aw immana geedda Xoossay qassi polanaw danddayiyaawaa loythi eriide bare ammanuwan minneeddawaappe attin, ammanennaan ixxiide, Xoossay immana geeddawaa sidhibeenna.
Hewaa diraw, Xoossay qassi A ammanuwaa xillotethaan paydeedda.
“Aw xillotethaan paydeedda” giyaa qaalay A xalalaw xaafettibeenna.
He qaalay nu Godaa Yesuusa hayquwaappe dentheedda Xoossaa ammaniyaa nuussikka xillotethaan paydettana mala xaafetteedda.
Xoossay A nu nagaraa diraw, hayqoo aathiide immina, I nuuna xillissanaw hayquwaappe denddeedda.
